focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚四国光伏产品加征反倾销税，中国组件企业需紧急调整出口布局
focus.summary: 据美国商务部8月中旬公布的初步裁定，其拟对从越南、泰国、马来西亚、柬埔寨进口的光伏电池及组件征收反倾销税，税率介于15%至271%之间。此举主要针对中国企业在当地设厂以规避双反关税的路径。受此影响，多家中国光伏制造商正重新评估东南亚产能布局，转向美国本土建厂或拓展中东、拉美市场。律师提示，相关企业应在终裁前完成供应链合规审查，并关注反规避调查的联动风险。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部公告及行业分析 · 2026.08.21
focus.title_en: US Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Solar Products from Four Southeast Asian Countries, Chinese Module Makers Urged to Adjust Export Strategies
focus.summary_en: According to a preliminary determination issued by the U.S. Department of Commerce in mid-August, it proposes anti-dumping duties ranging from 15% to 271% on solar cells and modules imported from Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, and Cambodia. The move primarily targets Chinese manufacturers that have set up facilities in these countries to circumvent existing anti-dumping and countervailing duties. In response, several Chinese solar firms are reassessing their Southeast Asian capacity, shifting to U.S. domestic manufacturing or exploring markets in the Middle East and Latin America. Counsel advises companies to complete supply chain compliance reviews before the final determination and to be mindful of the risk of parallel anti-circumvention investigations.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. Department of Commerce announcement and industry analysis · 2026.08.21

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决在中国法院获承认与执行，凸显跨境争议解决效率
case.summary: 近期，上海海事法院依据《纽约公约》承认并执行了新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）作出的一项仲裁裁决。该案涉及一家中国航运企业与新加坡船东之间的租船合同纠纷，裁决金额约500万美元。法院在审查中确认仲裁协议有效、程序无瑕疵，且不违反中国公共政策，遂裁定予以执行。此案表明，中国法院对国际商事仲裁持友好态度，为中外企业选择新加坡等境外仲裁地提供了信心，同时也提示企业应重视仲裁条款的起草与执行地的司法环境评估。
case.source: 来源：上海海事法院公开案例及法律数据库 · 2026.08
case.title_en: SIAC Arbitral Award Recognized and Enforced by Chinese Court, Highlighting Efficiency in Cross-Border Dispute Resolution
case.summary_en: Recently, the Shanghai Maritime Court recognized and enforced an arbitral award rendered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) under the New York Convention. The case involved a charter party dispute between a Chinese shipping company and a Singaporean shipowner, with the award amounting to approximately USD 5 million. The court confirmed the validity of the arbitration agreement, found no procedural irregularities, and concluded that enforcement would not violate Chinese public policy. This case demonstrates the pro-arbitration stance of Chinese courts, boosting confidence for Chinese and foreign enterprises in choosing overseas arbitral seats like Singapore, while also reminding parties to carefully draft arbitration clauses and assess the judicial environment at the enforcement seat.
case.source_en: Source: Public case from Shanghai Maritime Court and legal databases · 2026.08

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业合规路径进一步明确
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室于8月发布《粤港澳大湾区（内地、香港、澳门）个人信息跨境流动标准合同办法》，自2026年9月1日起施行。该办法允许大湾区内符合条件的企业通过签订标准合同实现个人信息跨境流动，简化了安全评估程序。适用主体包括在内地注册但业务涉及港澳的企业，以及港澳机构在内地的分支机构。企业需进行个人信息保护影响评估，并在合同签署后10个工作日内向省级网信部门备案。此举为跨境金融、医疗、物流等企业提供了更高效的数据合规路径。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室发布 · 2026.08
policy.title_en: New Rules on Cross-Border Data Flows in the Greater Bay Area Take Effect, Providing Clearer Compliance Paths for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the "Standard Contract Measures for Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Information in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao)" in August, effective from September 1, 2026. The Measures allow eligible enterprises within the GBA to transfer personal information across borders by signing standard contracts, streamlining the security assessment process. Applicable entities include companies registered in the mainland but with business involving Hong Kong and Macao, as well as branch offices of Hong Kong and Macao institutions in the mainland. Enterprises are required to conduct personal information protection impact assessments and file the contracts with the provincial cyberspace administration within 10 working days after signing. This provides a more efficient data compliance path for cross-border finance, healthcare, logistics, and other sectors.
policy.source_en: Source: Issued by the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.08

analysis.title: 美国出口管制实体清单扩容，中国半导体企业如何构建韧性合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期美国商务部将多家中国半导体设备、材料及设计公司列入实体清单，限制其获取美国技术。此举不仅影响直接采购，还通过外国直接产品规则波及供应链上下游。建议企业：一、全面梳理供应链中的美国管制物项，建立受管制物项清单及用途评估机制；二、针对可能被列入清单的“预防性合规”制定应急方案，包括替代供应商开发与许可申请预审；三、利用中国出口管制法的对等反制工具，评估合规风险；四、在合同中嵌入管制事件下的不可抗力或情势变更条款，以减轻违约责任。企业应提升合规投入，将出口管制纳入董事会层面的战略风险。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球涉外法律团队 · 2026.08.21
analysis.title_en: US Export Control Entity List Expansion: How Chinese Semiconductor Firms Can Build Resilient Compliance Systems
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The recent addition of multiple Chinese semiconductor equipment, materials, and design companies to the U.S. Entity List restricts their access to U.S. technology. This impacts not only direct procurement but also the supply chain upstream and downstream through the foreign direct product rule. It is advisable for companies to: 1) comprehensively map U.S. controlled items in their supply chain and establish a controlled item list and end-use assessment mechanism; 2) develop 'preventive compliance' contingency plans for potential listing, including alternative supplier development and pre-application for licenses; 3) leverage China's Export Control Law's countermeasure tools to assess compliance risks; and 4) incorporate force majeure or change of circumstances clauses in contracts to mitigate liability in case of control events. Enterprises should increase compliance investment and elevate export control to a board-level strategic risk.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law Cross-Border Legal Team · 2026.08.21
